messages.content: Hi, for user_01, please first check whether my investment account is active. Then see if NASDAQ is open and get Apple’s current price so you can use that quote to buy $1500 of AAPL in USD. After that, check the current price of BTC, then get a current snapshot for TSLA and use it to sell 5 shares. Also, please look up the weather in Paris, and finally cancel booking BK123456 because my travel plans changed after portfolio rebalancing.
